fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on alleged gambling and “crime commission” activity connected to Hialeah Park, criticism of the Salvation Army’s charitable practices using the case of blind man Ira Corwin, and discussion of Florida politics and public-utility policy including proposals involving Florida Power & Light. Also features national coverage on proposed health legislation and opposition lobbying by pharmaceutical/patent medicine firms, along with local columns, court/police notes, and extensive entertainment and nightclub advertising.
